tagline.title: Every metre accounted for.
tagline.text: Inventory, sales and credit in one system.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Use your phone number and password.
login.phone_incomplete: Enter the full phone number — 9 digits
login.forgot_text: A staff member's password is reset by the business owner. If you are the business owner, contact the platform administrator.

password.changed: Password changed. You will need to log in again on your other devices.
password.first_text: You were given a temporary password. Set a new one that only you know to start working.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Full name
profile.readonly_note: Name and phone cannot be changed here.
profile.language_hint: The chosen language applies on all your devices.

pin.locked_text: The wrong PIN was entered 5 times. Try again in {{time}}.
pin.use_password: Log in as the business owner

devices.title: Store devices
devices.intro: Each store has one shared device. You link it once — after that sellers log in on it with just a 4-digit PIN.
devices.bind_title: Link this device to a store
devices.name: Device name
devices.bind_warning: After linking you will be logged out of this device and it will accept PIN login only. Keep managing the business from your own device.
devices.already_bound: This device is currently linked to the store “{{store}}”. Linking it again will remove the old link.
devices.no_stores: No stores have been added yet. Stores are added in the Structure section.
devices.empty: No devices linked yet. Open this page on the store device and press “Link device”.
devices.revoke_confirm: Unlink this device? It will stop working immediately.

sell_by_kg.title: Sell by kg
sell_by_kg.hint: When kg is entered in a sale, metres are calculated automatically.

credit_enabled.title: Credit sales
credit_enabled.hint: When off, nothing can be sold on credit. Existing debts can still be paid in the Credit section.

credit_days.title: Credit period
credit_days.hint: A debt older than this is treated as overdue.

low_stock_default.title: Default low-stock threshold
low_stock_default.hint: Used when an item has no threshold of its own. May be left empty.

price_rounding.title: Price rounding
price_rounding.hint: Calculated prices are rounded to this precision.

autolock_minutes.title: Store device auto-lock
autolock_minutes.hint: If the device is not touched for this long, the PIN is asked again.

daily_summary_time.title: Daily summary time
daily_summary_time.hint: Owners who connected Telegram get the summary at this hour every day.

errors.credit_days: Enter a whole number from 1 to 365
errors.low_stock_default: Enter a positive number or leave it empty
errors.autolock_minutes: Enter a whole number from 1 to 480

login.failed: Login attempt with a wrong password
login.locked: Login paused after too many failed attempts

password.reset_by_platform: The platform administrator reset an owner's password
password.viewed_by_platform: The platform administrator viewed an owner's password

device.bound: Linked a device to a store

user.secret_viewed: Viewed a staff member's password or PIN

receipt.updated: Fixed a receipt's date or note

twofactor.title: Verification code
twofactor.text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twofactor.use_recovery: No phone with you? Use a recovery code
twofactor.use_app: Use the code from the app
twofactor.recovery_text: Enter one of the codes you were given when you connected the authenticator app. Each code works only once.
twofactor.setup_text: A password alone does not open the platform panel — every time you will also need the code shown by an app on your phone.
twofactor.step_app: Install Google Authenticator or a similar app on your phone.
twofactor.step_scan: Scan this QR code in the app, or enter the key by hand:
twofactor.step_code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twofactor.codes_text: If you lose your phone, these codes are the only way into the panel. They will not be shown again — write them down or keep them somewhere safe. Each code works once.
twofactor.codes_saved: I have saved the codes in a safe place

create.title: Add business
create.name: Business name
create.hint: The owner logs in with this number and a temporary password, and sets their own password on first login.
create.done_text: Pass these details to the owner. The password is shown only now.

card.reset_confirm: Create a new temporary password for {{name}}? The old password stops working and they are logged out of all devices.
card.reset_done: New temporary password. It is shown only now:
card.make_primary_text: {{name}} becomes the primary owner, and the current primary owner becomes a co-owner.
card.block_text: When blocked, all staff are logged out immediately and cannot log in. All data is kept.
card.unblock_text: The business is blocked. Once unblocked, staff can log in again — all data is in place.
card.password_missing: The password is not stored yet: it was set before this feature existed. It will appear after the owner's next login — or reset the password.
card.password_logged: This view was recorded in the business journal — the owner can see it.

structure.title: Structure
structure.name: Name

store.intro: A store holds stock, and sales are recorded there. A store is never deleted — deactivate it when it is no longer needed.
store.empty: No stores yet. Add the first one with “Add store”.
store.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this store? Its devices will be unlinked and sellers logged out of it.

warehouse.intro: New goods are received into a warehouse only; they reach a store by transfer. A warehouse is never deleted — deactivate it when it is no longer needed.
warehouse.empty: No warehouses yet. Add the first one with “Add warehouse”.
warehouse.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this warehouse? It will no longer appear in lists.

staff.intro: A seller logs in on the store device with a PIN only. A warehouse keeper and a co-owner log in with a phone number and password.
staff.password_hint: At least 6 characters. The staff member sets their own password on first login.
staff.pin_hint: 4 digits. Every active seller must have a different PIN.
staff.locations_required: Choose at least one location or turn on “all”
staff.no_locations: Nothing to choose from — add a store or warehouse first.
staff.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They are logged out of all devices immediately; their past actions are kept.
staff.created: {{name}} added. The PIN is set — the seller can log in on the store device.
staff.secret_missing: Not stored yet: it was set before this feature existed. It will appear after the staff member's next login — or set a new one now.
staff.secret_logged: This view was recorded in the activity journal.
staff.created_login: {{name}} added. They can sign in with their phone number and password.

structure.discard_draft: The form you started will be discarded — edit {{name}} instead?

image.label: Image
image.hint: Optional. JPG or PNG, up to 8 MB.

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.name: Name
catalog.similar_codes: A similar code exists: {{codes}}. Make sure this is a different item.

fabric.intro: A fabric is the base of the catalogue. You choose the code: digits, letters or symbols. A fabric is never deleted — deactivate it when it is no longer needed.
fabric.empty: No fabrics yet. Add the first one with “Add fabric”.
fabric.coefficient_hint: Optional. Applied to a batch at receiving; if a batch differs, it is changed there.
fabric.width_invalid: Width must be a whole number from 1 to 1000 cm
fabric.coefficient_invalid: Enter a positive number, for example 3.25

colors.intro: The colour list is shared by all fabrics. Pick a swatch and the colour is found faster in sales and lists.
colors.empty: No colours yet. Add the first one with “Add colour”.
colors.swatch_hint: Optional. Click the square to pick a colour.

patterns.intro: The pattern list is shared by all fabrics. For plain fabric, “Gulsiz” is always ready.
patterns.empty: No patterns yet. Add one with “Add pattern”; plain fabric uses “Gulsiz”.

sku.intro: A SKU is the item you sell: fabric + colour + pattern. It is created automatically at receiving; add it here to set a price in advance.
sku.need_setup: To add SKUs, first enter at least one fabric and one colour.
sku.empty: No SKUs yet. They are created at the first goods receipt, or add them with “Add SKUs”.
sku.bulk_unchanged: The chosen SKUs already had this price
sku.price_hint: The seller sees this price on the sales screen. If left empty, the seller types the price.
sku.equivalent: ≈ {{price}} — by the fabric's standard ratio (1 kg = {{coefficient}} m). In sales the batch's own ratio is used.
sku.no_coefficient: “Metres in 1 kg” is not set for this fabric — the kg/metre equivalent is not shown.
sku.threshold_hint_default: You are notified when stock falls below this. If left empty — the business default: {{value}} m.
sku.threshold_hint_none: You are notified when stock falls below this. If left empty, there is no notification for this SKU (no default threshold in settings).
sku.threshold_invalid: Enter a positive number, for example 50
sku.history_empty: The price has not been changed yet.
sku.inactive_note: An inactive SKU cannot be chosen at receiving, but its remaining stock can still be sold.

receiving.title: Goods in
receiving.intro: New goods are received into a warehouse only. Each line is a separate batch: it gets a number and a label to print.
receiving.empty: No goods receipts yet — start with “New goods receipt”.
receiving.sku_locked: Part of this batch has been sold or transferred — the item cannot be replaced.
receiving.new_sku: This SKU does not exist yet — it is added to the catalogue when you save.
receiving.coefficient_standard: If left empty — the fabric's standard: {{value}}
receiving.price_current: Now: {{price}}. If you change it, this SKU's price is updated.
receiving.price_none: No price set yet — you can set it here.
receiving.warn_coefficient: This gives 1 kg = {{value}} m, but the fabric's standard is {{standard}} m. Could metres or kg be mistyped?
receiving.warn_cost: The cost is higher than the recommended price.
receiving.warn_duplicate: This item is also in batch {{n}}.
receiving.no_warehouses: No active warehouse is assigned to you. The business owner adds and assigns warehouses under “Structure”.
receiving.no_catalog: A receipt needs at least one fabric and one colour in the catalogue.
receiving.created: Receipt saved. You can print the labels now.
receiving.cancel_confirm: Cancel this receipt? The batches' metres are removed from the warehouse; the receipt stays in the list marked “cancelled”.
receiving.locked_note: Part of this batch has been sold or transferred — only the business owner can fix it now.

errors.rolls: Enter a whole number, at least 1
errors.meters: Enter a positive number, for example 500 or 120.5
errors.kg: Enter a positive number or leave empty
errors.coefficient: Enter a positive number or leave empty

labels.title: Print labels
labels.intro: One label per roll; the barcode is the batch number. If one is lost, reprint it here at any time.
labels.too_many: No more than {{max}} labels can be printed at once

receiving.remove_confirm: Remove batch {{n}}? What you typed will be lost.

stock.intro: Stock is kept in metres; the roll count is approximate. Click a batch number to see its whole history.
stock.empty: No stock yet — it appears here once goods are received.

close.title: Close a batch
close.intro: When the rolls run out, the batch is closed: the metres left in the system are recorded as the “metre difference”. Scan the label or type the number.
close.question: Has the batch really run out here?
close.will_short: {{meters}} m will be recorded as short.
close.will_over: {{meters}} m will be recorded as over.
close.will_none: No difference — it came out as labelled.
close.big: The difference is large — {{percent}}% of what was received. Could a sale or transfer be missing?

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.intro: A transfer has two steps: it is sent, then the receiver confirms what actually arrived. Until then the goods are “in transit”.
transfer.empty: No transfers yet — start with “New transfer”.
transfer.search: Batch number or item (scanner goes here too)
transfer.nothing_to_send: There is nothing to send from this location.
transfer.sent_done: Transfer sent — the receiver has to confirm it.
transfer.no_sources: There is no location you can send from. A warehouse keeper sends only from an assigned warehouse.

errors.places: Choose where from and where to

transfer.cancel_confirm: Cancel this transfer? The metres return to “{{place}}”.

receive.note_required: There is a difference — write a note
receive.note_hint_diff: There is a difference — say what happened (required).
receive.diff_reported: The difference appears in the “Metre difference” report.
receive.done_diff: Received with a difference — it is shown in the Metre difference report.

differences.intro: The gap between labelled metres and what actually came out. It is found when a batch is closed and when a transfer is received.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: No notifications yet. Important events (transfer differences, low stock and others) appear here.

transfer.arrived: {{number}}: {{meters}} m arrived from “{{source}}” — please receive it
transfer.waiting: {{number}}: “{{target}}” has not received it for {{hours}} hours

sale.negative_stock: {{number}}: more than the recorded stock of {{batch}} sold at “{{store}}” — {{by}}: {{note}}

debt.overdue: {{customer}}: a debt of {{amount}} soʻm is overdue ({{number}}, due {{date}})

telegram.disconnected: Telegram was disconnected — the bot is blocked. Reconnect it in your profile to keep receiving messages.

sales.no_stores: No active stores yet. Stores are added in “Structure”.
sales.nothing_to_sell: Nothing to sell in this store. Goods arrive by transfer from the warehouse.
sales.pending: The sale was not sent — no internet. The basket is saved and will be sent once the connection is back.

entry.scan: Batch number or item (scan here too)
entry.no_recommended: No recommended price — enter the price yourself
entry.no_coefficient: No kg ↔ metre ratio for this batch — enter metres
entry.over_stock: The system shows {{available}} m left. If the fabric is really there, add it — you will write a note in the basket.
entry.not_found: Batch not found — choose the item by hand
entry.not_here: This batch is not in this store

cart.title: Basket
cart.empty: The basket is empty. Scan a label or choose an item.
cart.clear_confirm: Remove all {{count}} lines from the basket?
cart.note_placeholder: For example: the roll came out 2 m longer
cart.note_text: The system shows {{available}} m left in this batch — you are selling more than that. Write a note (required).
cart.note_text_plain: You are selling more than the recorded stock. Write a note (required).

credit.title: On credit: customer and down payment
credit.debt: Goes to the customer's debt: {{amount}} soʻm
credit.paid_in_full: Paid in full — this will be recorded as an ordinary sale.

errors.empty: The basket is empty — add at least one item
errors.note: Write a note for the line that exceeds the stock
errors.customer: Choose a customer for the credit sale
errors.initial: The down payment cannot exceed the total

list.empty: No sales yet. The first sale is recorded by a seller on the store device.
list.empty_today: You have not made a sale today yet.

return.title: Return goods
return.intro: Enter the metres that came back. They go back to the same batch in this store.

errors.empty: Enter returned metres for at least one line
errors.meters: Wrong metres — a positive number, no more than was sold

cancel.text: A sale entered by mistake is cancelled: the metres return to the store's stock and, for a credit sale, the debt is cancelled too.

credit.intro: Customers are shared across the business: they can buy on credit and pay at any store.
credit.empty: No customers yet. Customers are added during a credit sale or here.

customer.name: Name
customer.deactivate_confirm: Deactivate this customer? Their history is kept.

card.debts_empty: This customer has no credit sales.

pay.title: Debt payment
pay.done: Payment recorded: {{amount}} soʻm. Debt remaining: {{debt}} soʻm.

errors.too_large: The debt is {{debt}} soʻm — it cannot be more than that

writeoff.text: A written-off debt cannot be collected later. The business owner will be notified.

dashboard.chart_hint: Hover over a bar to see that day's sales

reports.vs_previous: Compared with the previous period of the same length
reports.no_revenue: not calculated when a fabric is selected
reports.profit_note: Profit = sales − cost of goods sold. The metre difference (fabric that came out short) and written-off debts are not included — they are shown separately.
reports.chart_sales_hint: Hover over a bar to see that period's sales
reports.hours_hint: Which hours of the day sell most
reports.weekdays_hint: Which days of the week sell most
reports.stock_intro: How much stock is at each location right now and what it is worth at cost.
reports.credit_note: Written-off debt is not subtracted from profit — it is shown here separately.
reports.deviation_intro: How far selling prices were from the recommended price. Sales without a recommended price are not included.

telegram.not_configured: The Telegram bot is not set up yet. For now notifications arrive only inside the system.
telegram.intro: Connect Telegram to get instant alerts about transfer differences and large metre differences, plus a daily summary.
telegram.waiting: Open the bot and press “Start” — this page will update by itself. The link works for 15 minutes.

daily_summary.title: Daily summary
daily_summary.hint: Every day: sales, money in, profit, low stock, overdue credit. The time is set in business settings.

instant_alerts.title: Instant alerts
instant_alerts.hint: When a transfer is received with a difference and when a batch is closed with a large difference.

shell.device_bound: This device is bound to the store “{{store}}” — sellers log in here with a PIN. You are logged in with your password.

errors.business_blocked: The business is temporarily blocked. Contact the platform administrator.
errors.account_inactive: Your account has been deactivated. Contact the business owner.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.pin_locked: The wrong PIN was entered 5 times. The device is locked for {{minutes}} min.
errors.device_not_bound: This device is not linked to a store. The business owner needs to link it again.
errors.same_password: The new password must differ from the old one
errors.network_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.server_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.session_expired: Your session has ended. Log in again.
errors.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Log in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action
errors.challenge_expired: Time is up. Enter your password again.
errors.setup_expired: The setup time is up. Log in again and scan the QR code once more.
errors.two_factor_already_set: An authenticator app is already connected. Log in again.
errors.two_factor_setup_required: Connect an authenticator app first. Log in again.
errors.phone_taken: This phone number is already in the system
errors.invalid_owner: This person cannot be made the primary owner
errors.status_unchanged: The business is already in this state
errors.pin_taken: This PIN is taken — choose another
errors.primary_owner_only: Only the primary owner can manage owners
errors.primary_owner_protected: The primary owner cannot be changed here
errors.seller_has_no_password: A seller has no password — they log in with a PIN
errors.pin_only_for_sellers: A PIN can only be set for a seller
errors.too_many_skus: Too many SKUs at once — choose fewer colours or patterns
errors.invalid_image: This file is not an image or is damaged
errors.image_too_large: The image is too large — up to 8 MB
errors.receipt_locked: Only the keeper who entered the receipt or the business owner can fix this; once the batch has sales — only the owner
errors.batch_has_movement: Part of the batch has been sold or transferred — this action is not possible
errors.sku_inactive: This SKU is inactive in the catalogue — reactivate it before receiving
errors.location_forbidden: This location is not assigned to you
errors.batch_not_open: The batch is not open at this location
errors.batch_not_closed: The batch is not closed at this location
errors.batch_in_transit: {{meters}} m are in transit — receive the transfer first
errors.transfer_not_in_transit: This transfer has already been received or cancelled
errors.location_has_stock: This location has stock or a transfer in transit — move the goods first
errors.store_required: A seller can only sell on a store device (with a PIN)
errors.credit_disabled: Credit sales are switched off in settings
errors.batch_not_here: {{batch}}: this batch is not in this store
errors.batch_closed: {{batch}}: the batch is closed in this store — it cannot be sold
errors.negative_stock_note_required: {{batch}}: the system shows {{available}} m left — write a note to sell more
errors.sale_has_returns: Goods from this sale have been returned — it can no longer be cancelled
errors.cancel_window_passed: A seller can cancel only their own sale within 10 minutes. Now the business owner has to do it.
errors.return_too_much: {{label}}: at most {{available}} m can be returned
errors.customer_phone_taken: This phone number belongs to another customer
errors.debt_has_payments: This debt has payments — the sale cannot be cancelled
errors.debt_not_found: Debt not found or already settled
errors.payment_too_large: The payment exceeds the debt — refresh the page and try again
errors.writeoff_too_large: The amount exceeds the remaining debt — refresh the page and try again
errors.customer_has_debt: A customer with debt cannot be deactivated
errors.telegram_not_configured: The Telegram bot is not set up yet

feedback.title: Sound and vibration
feedback.sound_hint: A short, quiet sound on taps, completed sales and errors. Saved on this device.
feedback.haptics_hint: A short vibration on taps on Android devices. iPhone/iPad browsers do not support vibration.
